name: railsync
description: RailSync - Distributed Railway Intelligence and Monitoring Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "GATEWAY,TRAIN,JOURNEY,RESERVE,ANALYTICS,CLIENT" -c "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue,white" "npx tsx watch services/gateway/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/train-intel/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/journey-station/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/reservation/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/analytics/server.ts" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -n "GATEWAY,TRAIN,JOURNEY,RESERVE,ANALYTICS" -c "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" "npx tsx watch services/gateway/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/train-intel/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/journey-station/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/reservation/server.ts" "npx tsx watch services/analytics/server.ts"
